interfaces.name: package_outline
interfaces.what: optical LGA16 module 6.4000 +/- 0.030 x 3.0300 +/- 0.030 x 1.7500 +/- 0.050 mm, corners 4 x R0.0750, substrate Z 0.2500 +/- 0.040, a 0.0200 mm top recess and a 0.0800 mm all-around clearance to the substrate edge; Rx aperture Ø0.5100. The frame is the module's MECHANICAL centre ON THE SEATING PLANE (z = 0 is the PCB land plane, +z out of the board). The drawing states the OPTICAL centre separately: it is offset 0.1000 mm from the mechanical centre, and the Rx aperture is Ø0.5100 +/- 0.030 mm. `accepts` is EMPTY on purpose: an SMT land joint is connection:solder-smt, which is NOT on this shelf — naming it would dangle, and a dangling ref is a FAIL in bin/triad check, never a warning. DISCRIMINATOR AGAINST THE L5CX, measured on both vendor drawings in the same session: identical 6.4000 x 3.0300 mm footprint, and the HEIGHT differs — 1.7500 +/- 0.050 here against 1.5000 +/- 0.050 on the VL53L5CX (DS13754 Rev 13 Figure 21, page 26/40). 0.2500 mm is a caliper-sized difference, so a real unit settles which generation part:microduck-tof-module carries.
interfaces.source: READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN MECHANICAL DRAWING: STMicroelectronics VL53L8CX datasheet DS14161 Rev 12, section 9 'Outline drawings', Figure 26 'Outline drawing (1/4)', PAGE 31 of 45 — the copy in this folder (current/datasheet.pdf, sha256 in current/PROVENANCE.json), read 2026-09-02 (lane T)
